what: First end-to-end run of the shipped Windows installer on a real Windows machine: silent install, true first launch (app mode, no overrides), real model download against the pinned hashes, real llama-server inference, one uploaded document, one question answered, the same question answered again from cache.

where.machine: GitHub Actions windows-latest (Microsoft Windows Server 2025 10.0.26100, Azure westus, 4 vCPU, no GPU - llama.cpp win-vulkan build on its CPU path)

measured.note_on_serving_time: Includes downloading and SHA-256-verifying 2,581,387,744 bytes of models and loading both llama-servers. The download rode Azure-to-CDN bandwidth; a home connection will dominate this number, and the download resumes if interrupted.

first_answer.question: What is the monthly pet cleaning fee?
first_answer.answer: The monthly pet cleaning fee is EUR 15 [pet-policy].
first_answer.llama_timings: prompt 551 tokens at 22.0 tok/s prefill, 15 tokens generated at 7.8 tok/s, on 2 threads

asserted_by_the_run: installer places OpenKnowledgeApp.exe and llama/llama-server.exe where the launcher looks
app-mode provisioning minted OK_ADMIN_TOKEN into the per-user .env and enabled uploads, with no environment overrides
both models downloaded, hash-verified against the manifest, and loaded
POST /documents indexed the upload immediately (1 document, 1 chunk, embeddings computed)
the answer contains the fact, is grounded, and cost exactly zero
the same question asked twice returned byte-identical answers, the second from the exact cache
failures_on_the_way_recorded_because_eac: run 5: launcher died natively in under a second with empty logs - the frozen Tk progress window (Tcl_Panic aborts below Python); fixed by console-first progress reporting
run 5 (latent, found by inspection while diagnosing): os.fchmod does not exist on Windows Python 3.12 and app-mode token provisioning called it; guarded
runs 1-2 (installer job): case-insensitive executable name collision, then llama.cpp's release layout change - see the roadmap entry
caveats: One question over one document is a smoke of the shipped artifact, not an accuracy claim; accuracy claims live in the golden-set runs.
The runner has no GPU and no interactive desktop: the Vulkan GPU path, the tray icon, the Tk first-run window of the windowed exe, and SmartScreen behaviour remain unexercised.
The runner's session is not a consumer desktop; a hands-on install on a physical Windows machine is still worth one afternoon.
